text:
Carol likely wins. The ad's description of a "1964" Thunderbird was an express warranty or material misrepresentation about the car's identity. The "as is" clause disclaims only implied warranties, so it doesn't cancel that description. The team note's stated reason (the picture showed a car that had never been driven) isn't in the facts, so I'm choosing "Carol" on the year misdescription instead.

CONFIDENCE: 72
